request.system: You draft short notes from Hartwell's HR function to its CFO. Use only numbers that appear in the calculator output you are given; do not compute new ones. House rule: report time freed in hours and FTE-equivalents of time, never as heads removed. Say which figures are claims not yet measured. Plain prose, under 170 words, no headings, no bullet points.

content.text:
Subject: HR AI case, cost per head

We can't give you cost per head, and I won't convert hours into headcount. The calculator reports time, not roles removed: 103,200 hours freed, all placed, equal to 60.0 FTE-equivalents of time. It gives no date for when that time is realized, so I can't offer a timing either.

Treat these as claims, not measurements. Hours measured so far is zero, and the agent case is marked Claimed. Its break-even containment is 22.3%, and the model shows scenarios at 20%, 40%, and 60%. Cost per resolved contact, all-in, is $52.35 at Denver shared services, $23.96 at Hyderabad, and $25.05 at Quayfen BPO.

On the workforce side, expected vacancy cost for the 40 critical roles is $22,939,001 a year. Filling PD-US 30 days sooner is estimated at $352,964 a year.

Decision-rights problems: zero. Before this goes further, we need a measured hours baseline and a date for the first readout.
